1. ch33Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0234

Throughout this chapter, $(\mathcal M^3,g(t))$ is a connected, closed, orientable nonsingular solution of the normalized Ricci flow in Case III which has a complete noncompact hyperbolic limit. A finite-volume hyperbolic limit $(\mathcal H^3,h)$ is connected, orientable, complete, and noncompact. For $A>0$, write $\mathcal H_A$ for the compact truncation obtained by cutting each standard cusp at its torus of area $A$.
